column1: # The four published real-time PCR assays of Hoover E., Chmara J., Duceppe M., Charron P., Lloyd D.,
# Huang H., Surujballi O., Thanthrige-Don N., Arnold K., Hazelwood J. and Kang M. (2026), "Two novel
# real-time PCR assays for Brucella detection: a species-specific multiplex and a genus-level singleplex
# developed via large-scale whole genome sequencing data analysis", Microbiol Spectr 14:e02974-25,
# doi:10.1128/spectrum.02974-25 -- their Table 1. One genus-level singleplex and a three-species multiplex.
# The regions were found with selective_primer_finder 0.2.1 (the direct ancestor of this package) and RUCS
# 1.0.3, on 1,597 assemblies the authors built from SRA reads, and then checked in silico against 1,160
# classical Brucella and 194 non-Brucella RefSeq assemblies.
# Probe sequences are given without their dye (FAM, ABY or JUN on the 5' end) and quencher (QSY).
# `locus` is the annotation the paper reports the region in (its Table 2).
